description: Cleared the plates and took the table back.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Repeated the two sums and refused to price a barrel.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Named five pound and a lease, and left both as a sentence.
name: James Burbage

description: Looked at you when Pope proposed lowering Kemp, and chose the glass over the chair.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Proposed they lower Kemp, and conceded the sentence.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Asked for a barrel, was refused, and walked out on his feet.
name: Will Kemp

description: Refused the rope, repeated that the parts are not cast, and kept the castle in the air.
name: William Shakespeare
